jessica: Heads-up: planning a rolling swap of API client bindings from v2.3.0 -> v3.0.0 overnight. Target start 02:00 UTC Friday. Need deploy owner, smoke + rollback readiness, and customer comms.
omar: I can own the deploy window. I'll run preflight at 23:30 UTC and stand by for the swap.
kevin: I'll handle post-deploy telemetry + consumer checks. Will script smoke metrics.
tay: Quick Q — are all backward compatibility tests green? I saw flaky failures in `streaming_chunking` on python3.9.
jessica: Test matrix mostly green. Only streaming_chunking on py3.9 flaky (see run: https://ci.internal/flow/3456). We'll snapshot failure and patch if it blocks.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled window created by @omar: start=2024-05-12T02:00Z duration=90m window-id=wnd_807
omar: Rollback plan: proxy can route back to v2 immediately. Command: `curl -sS -XPOST https://ops.internal/api/route -d 'version=v2'`. Also have infra job `rollback-restore` in runbooks.
sre-oncall: I'll watch error rate + p50/p95 latency. If error rate >5% or p95 increases >2x during canary, I'll ask to cut traffic.
marketing-liaison: Customer comms: 24h pre-deploy email going out. Also prepare an in-product banner after 1h stable. Draft shared in #marketing-drafts.
kevin: Smoke checklist I'll run: 1) simple generate, 2) streaming smoke, 3) embeddings sanity, 4) perf short-run. Command: `./scripts/smoke_run.sh --env canary --quick`.
jessica: We need to ensure older clients still accept `Client.create()` without the new `mode` arg. If not, we'll add a proxy shim.
omar: I can hotpatch a param shim in the proxy layer, it's low risk.
tay: I'll review the shim PR (#4378) and merge if green. Will ping reviewers.
jessica: Canary plan: 5% for 20m -> 25% for 40m -> full. Owners: please ack + confirm watch channels.
omar: ack
kevin: ack
tay: ack
sre-oncall: ack
marketing-liaison: ack
jessica: Thanks — will post final runbook + links 1h before window. :rocket:
